verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Fastmail offering an AI assistant that answers grounded questions across mail and calendar. JMAP API access, API tokens and standard mail search are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the capability itself. One community user also notes Fastmail lacks Gmail-style implicit organisation and summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
